issues.detail: 빈칸 문맥 완성. Stem/passage: 'Dabbawalas owe their success to an __________ and a strong sense of work.' The blank is preceded by the article 'an', which forces the correct phrase to start with a vowel sound. Choices: ① expensive machine (vowel 'e') ② strict schedule (consonant 's' — grammatically impossible after 'an') ③ efficient organization (vowel 'e', correct) ④ large factory (consonant 'l' — grammatically impossible after 'an'). Two of four distractors (②④) can be eliminated purely by article-noun agreement without reading or understanding the passage, cutting the effective guessing pool from 4 to 2 and letting grammar substitute for comprehension.

(A)(B)(C) 조합형 items 1–3 all share the identical correct-position pattern across their three bracket pairs: A=1st-listed word, B=2nd-listed word, C=1st-listed word. Q1: unique(1st)-dedicated(2nd)-carefully(1st). Q2: various(1st)-manage(2nd)-effective(1st). Q3: planned(1st)-efficient(2nd)-cooperation(1st). All three of this test's combo items follow the exact same 1-2-1 slot pattern, which a test-wise student could notice after the first item or two and use to narrow the answer without evaluating each word's meaning.
Same cross-item pattern flagged on Q1: correct combo for Q2 is also position1-position2-position1 (various-manage-effective), identical structural slot pattern to Q1 and Q3. See Q1 issue for detail.

Same cross-item pattern flagged on Q1: correct combo for Q3 is also position1-position2-position1 (planned-efficient-cooperation), identical structural slot pattern to Q1 and Q2. See Q1 issue for detail.

빈칸 어휘 완성. Blank: 'They are then taken to the nearest train __________.' Choices: station, market, factory, office. 'Train station' is an extremely strong, near-exclusive real-world collocation — 'train market/factory/office' are semantically implausible on their own without reading any passage context. The item is solvable by generic English collocation knowledge alone, bypassing the intended comprehension check of the dabbawala passage.

문맥상 부적절한 어휘 (보통 난이도). Marker ①ignore in '...work in and around Mumbai and ①ignore about 400,000 lunch box deliveries daily. This operation runs with remarkable accuracy...' The swapped word is a near-total antonym of the intended 'manage', and the very next sentence describing 'remarkable accuracy' of the operation makes the contradiction self-evident within the same short span — arguably easier than the '보통' (medium) difficulty tag suggests, though still within acceptable range for this question type.
